theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Utilities (+2.52%) and Industrials (+1.11%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.16%) and Financials (-0.04%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.40%, defensives +1.00%, and value/cyclicals +0.73% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.68%, Dow +0.45%, Nasdaq +0.63% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.45%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 2.51% to 15.13, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.86% to $4,190.20, crude oil was little changed at $89.43, and bitcoin slipped 0.24% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
